sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Any indication of corrosion or discoloration at Speed tronic frame, due to heat, should be 
 investigated and the equipment repaired or replaced as necessary.

The relative humidity of the speed tronic control page location should be 
 maintained at 50% or less to minimize any possible corrosion problems.
